shortDescription: Module for setup of SSLKeyAndCertificate Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: ca_certs
options.description: Ca certificates in certificate chain.

options.name: certificate
options.description: Sslcertificate settings for sslkeyandcertificate.

options.name: certificate_base64
options.description: States if the certificate is base64 encoded. Field introduced in 18.1.2, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: certificate_management_profile_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type certificatemanagementprofile.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: created_by
options.description: Creator name.

options.name: dynamic_params
options.description: Dynamic parameters needed for certificate management profile.

options.name: enckey_base64
options.description: Encrypted private key corresponding to the private key (e.g. Those generated by an hsm such as thales nshield).

options.name: enckey_name
options.description: Name of the encrypted private key (e.g. Those generated by an hsm such as thales nshield).

options.name: format
options.description: Format of the key/certificate file. Enum options - SSL_PEM, SSL_PKCS12. Field introduced in 18.1.2, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SSL_PEM.

options.name: hardwaresecuritymodulegroup_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type hardwaresecuritymodulegroup.

options.name: key
options.description: Private key.

options.name: key_base64
options.description: States if the private key is base64 encoded. Field introduced in 18.1.2, 18.2.1. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: key_params
options.description: Sslkeyparams settings for sslkeyandcertificate.

options.name: key_passphrase
options.description: Passphrase used to encrypt the private key. Field introduced in 18.1.2, 18.2.1.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the object.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: status
options.description: Enum options - ssl_certificate_finished, ssl_certificate_pending. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SSL_CERTIFICATE_FINISHED.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: type
options.description: Enum options - ssl_certificate_type_virtualservice, ssl_certificate_type_system, ssl_certificate_type_ca.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.
